reason: This capacitor is part of an output RC network (with R2/R3/R0/R1) typically used for frequency compensation, filtering, or test loading; the core differential amplifier action is still present without it. Removing it mainly affects AC stability/peaking and transient response rather than DC gain/biasing.
impact_estimate: Low for DC/functional behavior; Medium for AC stability/bandwidth/transient response (possible ringing/peaking depending on load and feedback).

reason: R3 looks like an output load/bleeder to ground to define VOUT1’s DC level or emulate a measurement load; the amplifier can still operate without a dedicated load resistor if the next stage or testbench provides loading. impact_estimate: Low if VOUT1 is otherwise loaded/defined; Medium if VOUT1 would otherwise be floating in DC or if a specific load was required for biasing/measurement.
